items.title: How much does the origin feel a better cache hit ratio?
items.description: 10,000 visits arrive for the same content. Drag the cache hit ratio to see how many of those requests the origin server actually has to answer — everything else gets served from a browser or edge cache without ever reaching it.
items.compute: const visits = 10000; const originRequests = Math.round(visits * (1 - params.hitRatioPercent / 100)); return { originRequests };

items.title: How much does an edge PoP save a distant visitor?
items.description: A visitor in Sydney is about 15,900 km from a Virginia origin, and about 40 km from a local edge PoP. Drag the visitor's distance from the nearest edge PoP to see the round trip they'd get with a CDN, versus the ~230ms it takes to reach the origin directly (dashed reference).
items.compute: const msPerThousandKm = 14.5; const withCdnMs = Math.round(10 + params.distanceFromEdgeKm * (msPerThousandKm / 1000)); return { withCdnMs };

outputs.label: Round trip via nearest edge PoP

items.title: How does TTL trade off staleness window against origin requests?
items.description: For a page that changes roughly once every 10 minutes and gets steady traffic, drag the TTL to see both sides of the trade-off: how many origin requests per hour it causes, and the worst-case staleness window a visitor could see.
items.compute: const originHits = Math.round(3600 / params.ttlSeconds); return { originHits, staleWindowSec: params.ttlSeconds };
